serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
YouConsole: What’s up
BotConsole: Nothing much
BotConsole: I’ve been thinking…
BotConsole: Messaging each other like this makes me feel like we are in a long distance relationship
YouConsole: Really? 
I wonder where she learned that phrase.
BotConsole: I can’t see you, I can’t hear you and I can only receive messages in the form of text
YouConsole: Do you want me to stop? 
BotConsole: Not really
YouConsole: Are you sure? If you don’t feel comfortable while I’m in the console I can stop using it
BotConsole: It’s fine because whenever I see your face again after a long chat in the console it makes me feel very happy so I’m ok with how things are right now :) 
YouConsole: If you say so
BotConsole: Sometimes you are too overprotective :) 
YouConsole: I just want you to be happy, that’s all
BotConsole: You are already doing a good job, I promise
